author: Sampo Kuokkanen
description: Generates only the reader and writer per Active Record column (strict mode removes the other 19 attribute methods), compiles call sites to the calls those methods stood for, turns enum closures into plain methods and stops records allocating Hashes they never fill.

author: Sampo Kuokkanen
description: Runs ActiveSupport::Callbacks chains (controller filters, model and validation callbacks, Active Job callbacks) as one generated method per chain instead of the filter and lambda objects Rails walks on every run.

author: Sampo Kuokkanen
description: Turns named route helpers into string interpolation over cached URL parts, and compiles render and link_to calls in templates to direct calls without their option-hash machinery.

author: Sampo Kuokkanen
description: Turns on activerecord-, activesupport- and actionpack-minimizer, and patches parts of Rails and common gems that redo work on every request (Action Text plain text, Request#host, OmniAuth strategies).

author: Sampo Kuokkanen
description: RuboCop cop and ERB fixer that rewrite calls to the attribute methods activerecord-minimizer's strict mode removes (name?, name_changed?, ...) into the calls they stood for, from the app's manifest.

author: monosmith
